column1: # Branches whose runner has RETURNED a result. Written by the orchestrator only.
# liveness-check.sh infers "is an agent working here" from file writes, because it cannot see
# agents. That inference is wrong in one direction it cannot fix by itself: a worktree whose runner
# FINISHED is quiet forever, and quiet-because-done is indistinguishable from quiet-because-dead by
# any reading of the filesystem. On 2026-08-26 it called `ai/m32` stalled at exactly 35m; M32 had
# returned a complete report and was waiting to be verified.
# So delivery is recorded rather than inferred, and only the orchestrator knows it.
# THE EXEMPTION EXPIRES BY CONSTRUCTION. Each row names the tip the branch was delivered at. If the
# branch has moved past that tip, work is in flight again and the row stops exempting anything —
# so this file cannot be used to silence the gate for a branch that is genuinely being worked on,
# and a stale row degrades to no row rather than to a permanent pass.
